ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (36) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Земля» (zemlya) is 'land' in the property sense and 'the earth' where it means the world; «Великий дух» (Velikiy dukh) is Black Hawk's 'Great Spirit', with lowercase pronouns as in the source, and «разум» (razum) is 'reason' (the website draft had 'mind'). «Блак Хаук» (Blak Khauk) is Black Hawk and «Жерард Винстанлей» (Zherard Vinstanley) Gerrard Winstanley; Leviticus 25:23 is translated from Tolstoy's wording («никогда», nikogda, 'never').
